The '''Cloak of the Kursk''' was a [[Color/Legends|black]] robe worn by the leader of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] using tradition known as the [[Blackguard (Mustafar)/Legends|Blackguard]], who held the title of [[Kursk]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] the Kursk of the Blackguard at the time, [[San'sii]], was killed by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] hired by a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] named [[Mi Fon Lu]] to clear the [[Southern Jedi Ruins]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] where the Blackguard were based. The Cloak was taken by the spacers who killed San'sii as loot.<ref name="SWG:ToO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The cloak of the Kursk first appeared as an item in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' expansion [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|Trials of Obi-Wan]] released in [[2005]]. The item was available only as a drop from killing [[San'sii]] whom was an elite enemy targeted in the quest "An Archaeologist's Problem". The cloak later appeared in San'sii's card in the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]] expansion pack [[Agents of Deception]] which was released in [[2009]].
